tcc_system.query: SELECT service, client, auth_value, indirect_object_identifier FROM access

tcc_user.query: SELECT service, client, auth_value, indirect_object_identifier FROM access

tcc_user_container.query: SELECT service, client, auth_value, indirect_object_identifier FROM access

views.tcc: SELECT service, client, nullif(indirect_object_identifier, 'UNUSED') AS target, max(CAST(auth_value AS INTEGER)) AS auth_value FROM (SELECT service, client, auth_value, indirect_object_identifier FROM tcc_system UNION ALL SELECT service, client, auth_value, indirect_object_identifier FROM tcc_user_container UNION ALL SELECT service, client, auth_value, indirect_object_identifier FROM tcc_user WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tcc_user_container)) GROUP BY service, client, target
views.console_user: SELECT u.username, u.directory FROM users u JOIN logged_in_users l ON l.user = u.username WHERE l.tty = 'console' LIMIT 1
